chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ays ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who had intercourse with his wife when he had sacrificed, before he visited the House. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should spill blood.'
ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for a pilgrim who has sex with his wife after sacrificing but before Tawaf?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that sexual intercourse during Hajj, even after the initial sacrifice, constitutes a major breach of Ihram sanctity requiring the expiation of 'spilling blood' (Damm). This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly view that the prohibitions of Ihram remain in full force until the completion of all essential rites, emphasizing the gravity of maintaining ritual purity throughout the pilgrimage journey. The term 'spilling blood' specifically refers to the obligation of offering a sacrificial animal, highlighting the tangible consequence of violating the sacred state.
